note: Bracken County has zoning (county zoning text and maps accepted by the Bracken County Municipal Planning and Zoning Commission ~2018; Augusta Ch. 154 establishes that commission). No public ArcGIS REST or other queryable service of the zoning district polygons was found in ArcGIS Hub/Online searches or web searches. County Beacon (Schneider) parcel viewer is the only county GIS portal found and does not expose a public zoning service. Zoning maps appear to be distributed via the clerk offices, not as queryable data. Augusta has no zoning GIS found either.
